# EBSCO

> EBSCO is a leading provider of research databases, eBooks, and discovery services for academic institutions and libraries worldwide.

EBSCO Information Services offers comprehensive access to peer-reviewed journals, full-text databases, and research platforms through products like EBSCOhost and Academic Search Ultimate. The company serves as a critical infrastructure provider for institutional research and learning, complemented by specialized content platforms like EBSCO Research that offer curated reference materials.

## Key Topics

- EBSCO Information Services

## Research Starters - Health & Medicine

- [Developmental disabilities | Health and Medicine | Research Starters | EBSCO Research](https://www.ebsco.com/research-starters/health-and-medicine/developmental-disabilities): Research Starter guide on developmental disabilities, causes, and community support
- [Cerebral palsy | Health and Medicine | Research Starters | EBSCO Research](https://www.ebsco.com/research-starters/health-and-medicine/cerebral-palsy): Research Starter overview of cerebral palsy motor disorders and management
- [Traumatic brain injury | Health and Medicine | Research Starters | EBSCO Research](https://www.ebsco.com/research-starters/health-and-medicine/traumatic-brain-injury): Research Starter on traumatic brain injury causes, symptoms, and recovery
